text: ポケモンが　おれ　くらい　カラテ　できれば　いいんだが…

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.span: できれば　いいんだが
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in ば followed by いい says 'it would be good if', a wish. The んだが left hanging at the end adds 'but sadly they can't'. できれば　いいんだが = 'if only they could do it...'

patterns.name: 〜くらい
patterns.explanation: くらい after a word means 'to about the same level as' that word. おれ　くらい = 'as well as me'.
